title: Corrected Chebyshev MNIST/CIFAR-10 frozen-adjoint recheck
training: Six CAT-bound models, three seeds per dataset, 8,000 examples per seed, width 64, at most 20 epochs; original checkpoints not archived so models deterministically retrained
audit: Eight held-out examples per dataset/seed, one identical frozen checkpoint and implicit-gradient target for three solvers
stopping: relative implicit-gradient error <= 1e-6, compared offline against direct solve
independent_verification: 144 action counts and relative errors independently recomputed using the six uploaded-to-conversation NPZ checkpoint files
checkpoint_status: NPZ checkpoints are not stored in this GitHub update; their raw bytes have been retained in the user's local experiment output
note: Older MNIST/CIFAR Chebyshev values in historical summary files are superseded only for the Chebyshev comparison; original CAT and AR learning results remain unchanged.
